name: Browserless MCP Server
summary: Hosted MCP server giving AI assistants full browser automation on Browserless cloud browsers; a lighter Connector endpoint is also offered.
description: Full server at https://mcp.browserless.io/mcp; the Connector (https://mcp.browserless.io/mcp/connector) covers navigation, reading, forms, screenshots, Lighthouse audits, search and export. Auth via OAuth (Browserless login) or an Authorization header.

agent_access.notes: Clients without OAuth can send an Authorization header.
